posts.title: Whistle While You Code
posts.overview: Every developer has a soundtrack. Whether it's lo-fi beats, thrash metal, absolute silence, or the ambient hum of a coffee shop — the music you write code to is not a neutral backdrop. It's an active ingredient.

posts.title: No Such Thing As A Full Stack Developer
posts.overview: We've been collectively pretending that a single developer can be genuinely excellent at both frontend and backend work. I think it's time to have an honest conversation about why that's mostly not true — and what it means for how we build teams.

posts.title: Create React App
posts.overview: Create React App was the scaffolding tool that introduced a generation of developers to React. It served its purpose brilliantly. And it's time to move on — not because it's broken, but because the web has moved well past what it was designed for.
